caption: The drawing depicts a wooden puppet-like figure standing on a rectangular two-tiered base, with one foot on a higher pinkish block and the other on a brown block. The figure is painted with reddish-brown skin, wears a striped black and gray tunic with uneven sleeves and a skirt with fringe at the hem, and has light tan or yellowish hair. The head is topped with a silver helmet adorned with two yellow and one red feather. The figure’s facial features are painted, showing prominent red cheeks and lips. The right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand resting on its hip, while the left arm is positioned across the front, holding a small stringed instrument resembling a mandolin or lute, which is brown with black accents and white tuning pegs. The feet are painted to resemble sandals. The background is plain off-white.
title: Indian Doll - Winnipeg Brave
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
